mapper.select: SELECT DATE(reservation.start_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS room_usage_count, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, reservation.start_time, reservation.end_time)) AS total_usage_minutes FROM reservation WHERE reservation.status = 1 -- 已确认的预约 AND reservation.start_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP by DATE(reservation.start_time) order by date

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS fault_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handled_fault_count FROM device_fault WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND DATE_ADD(#{endTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) group by DATE(create_time) order by date
